findings.evidence: PR lines 51 and 120 use `[NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] ... [Coalgebra R C]`; Mathlib `Bialgebra` is the structure where algebra and coalgebra are compatible (`mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Basic.lean:57`), and multiplication is available as a coalgebra hom only under `[Bialgebra R A]` (`mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/TensorProduct.lean:218`).
findings.fix: Put `tensorCoact` and `tensorCoact_natural` in a bialgebra section, e.g. require `[Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]` (or otherwise rename/document the map as only an arbitrary multiplication-combined coaction candidate).
findings.issue: `tensorCoact` is documented as the tensor-product coaction for comodules over a bialgebra, but it only assumes `[Coalgebra R C]` plus an unrelated `NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C`; for such a `C`, multiplication need not be compatible with counit/comultiplication, so this map is not necessarily a valid coaction candidate.

summary: The diagonal tensor coaction is exposed under hypotheses weaker than the stated bialgebra setting, so the declaration can be used where the advertised coaction need not satisfy the comodule laws.
